project.name: EventLive
project.type: public Saudi live-events static platform plus harvest pipeline

gates.name: Feature & CRUD Completeness
gates.evidence: Product journey audit PASS: visitor, organizer, and owner flows have verified starts, steps, and end states.

gates.name: UX Flows & IA
gates.evidence: Role-based journey map and dead-end audit PASS, with launch and visual sweeps covering public routes.

gates.name: Design-System Consistency
gates.evidence: Design OS report plus 41-page / 82-screenshot visual sweep.

gates.name: Code Review & Static Analysis
gates.evidence: Static analysis audit PASS: script syntax, package script references, and high-risk automation patterns checked.

gates.name: Tests & Coverage
gates.evidence: `npm run launch:preflight` PASS recorded in reports/launch-preflight-status.md.

gates.name: Error / Empty / Loading / Success States
gates.evidence: UI state audit PASS across browse, today, live screen, and organizer surfaces.

gates.name: Dependency & Supply-Chain Health
gates.evidence: `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean for high/critical production vulnerabilities; lockfile exists.

gates.name: Accessibility WCAG 2.1 AA + RTL
gates.evidence: Axe accessibility audit PASS with score >=95 and Lighthouse accessibility minimum >=95 across critical pages.

gates.name: Performance / Core Web Vitals
gates.evidence: Lighthouse performance audit PASS with minimum score >=90 across home, browse, live screen, and event detail.

gates.name: Responsive & Device Matrix
gates.evidence: Browser matrix PASS across Chromium/WebKit and mobile/tablet/desktop, with horizontal overflow and console checks.

gates.name: Reliability, Capacity & Failure Modes
gates.evidence: Operations readiness PASS: local critical-path load check, source failure-mode matrix, browser matrix, and reliability scripts verified.

gates.name: Security Review
gates.evidence: Security review audit PASS across static site, CI security steps, owner-only exposure, robots/sitemap/manifest, external links, secrets, and compliance controls.

gates.name: Config, Secrets & Env Parity
gates.evidence: Secret/env audit PASS: repository scan clean, env matrix script present, deployment workflow present, and git-history policy documented.

gates.name: Data Integrity & Migrations
gates.evidence: Validation clean; dedupe regression exists; public events=429. Static project has no DB migrations.

gates.name: Content & Localization
gates.evidence: Content/localization audit PASS and terminology glossary published.

gates.name: Compliance / Privacy / Source Rights
gates.evidence: Privacy, terms, and source-rights pages PASS and source harvest policy is classified.

gates.name: SEO & Discoverability
gates.evidence: Launch preflight includes sitemap, structured data, SEO content, production domain, AI search readiness, and launch sweep checks.

gates.name: Observability & Monitoring
gates.evidence: Operations readiness PASS: analytics, owner command center, alert scripts, monitoring plan, and incident runbook verified.

gates.name: Analytics & Instrumentation
gates.evidence: Analytics status PASS; regression excludes owner pages and tracks critical events.

gates.name: Notifications & Deliverability
gates.evidence: Current public static product does not send transactional email/SMS/WhatsApp.
gates.remaining: Reopen when organizer accounts, reminders, or submissions send messages.

gates.name: Release / Deploy / Rollback / DR
gates.evidence: Release/deploy/rollback audit PASS: commit, GitHub Actions, public URL verification, and rollback drill evidence are recorded.

gates.name: Documentation
gates.evidence: Documentation audit PASS: visitor, organizer, owner operations, incident runbook, readiness playbook, and terminology glossary are present.

gates.name: Final Sign-offs
gates.evidence: Requires owner approval after all non-reserved gates are PASS or explicitly accepted.
gates.remaining: Owner sign-off is intentionally not automated.
